method: Actual immutable baseline renderer, 1280x720 canvas toDataURL from supported captureBuffer. No HUD copied into texture; no style or image editing. Each scene reached by existing control-only driver and real launch button under controlled clock. Original visible-context screenshots and motion traces retained. Art capture, not performance evidence.

display.method: Original Driver-home approximation; game-rendered selected-build thumbnail. Speed/RPM/gear use actual telemetry. Unsimulated fields unavailable. At most10Hz changed-value upload, only nearby/front-facing/in-view; no rival displays.

recovery.policy: Fresh scored attempt at grid; no reward for abandoned attempt
